description: This file is a build configuration/makefile script defining build rules for firmware images for a Sercomm device platform. It includes variable definitions, scripts for cryptography, image segmentation, and device-specific build instructions.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-append-tail
methods.description: Appends a tail of specific bytes to a device image file.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-crypto
methods.description: Encrypts and processes the device image with cryptographic tools.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-factory-cpj
methods.description: Prepares factory images with specific kernel and root filesystem segmentation.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-factory-cqr
methods.description: Creates a device-specific header with hardware and software version info.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-kernel
methods.description: Adds a kernel header to the kernel image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-kernel-factory
methods.description: Creates kernel headers for factory images.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-mkhash
methods.description: Generates and inserts a hash into the device image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-part-tag
methods.description: Creates a device partition tag for a specified partition.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-part-tag-common
methods.description: Shared logic for applying partition tags to files.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-payload
methods.description: Creates a device payload with versioning and padding.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-pid-setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the image based on the provided position.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-prepend-tagged-kernel
methods.description: Prepends a tagged kernel to the kernel image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-sysupgrade-cpj
methods.description: Creates a system upgrade image for CPJ variant device.
